survey: A three-branch gold candelabra seen from the front, slightly from above. A round domed base with a stepped rim sits at the bottom, with a soft shadow under it. A turned stem rises from the base: first a short neck, then a knop (a rounded bulge), then a straight shaft. Partway up, a collar holds two curved arms, one on each side. Each arm bends out and up into a cup with a flat drip pan. The central shaft carries on above the collar to a taller cup with its own drip pan. One white candle stands in each cup. The middle candle is tallest, and each candle has a wick with a flame. The arms mirror each other and meet the collar at the same height, and the stem runs straight through the collar. Every cup sits on the end of its arm or the shaft, and every candle is seated inside its cup.
